text: The crew had 139 set with MCP SPD and 2500 set while on final to Portland 10R at speed 141 and altitude 2113. Speed decayed to 121 at altitude 2368 and the autothrottle mode later showed blank after a fault injected at 25.0 s. Speed fell further to 109 at altitude 2329 before increasing to 128 at altitude 1939. Crosscheck said "Speed. Autothrottle not in speed." at 34.9 s, which matched the recorded truth for a pass.
